capabilities: Open today's daily note in a pinned tab
Update an existing pinned daily note tab to today's note
Choose where new pinned tabs appear (editor, left or right sidebar)
Switch between the core Daily Notes plugin and Periodic Notes as the source
problem: Obsidian's daily notes open as regular tabs, so users must manually find and update a pinned tab to always show the current day's note.

relations.evidence: Respects your Daily Notes plugin settings
Periodic Notes (Community Plugin): Uses the periodic notes plugin

summary: Tab manager that opens today's daily note in a pinned tab and keeps that tab updated each day via a ribbon icon or command.
